title: Living Well: A Short Guide to Emotional Wellness
description: An introduction to understanding your emotions, recognizing patterns, and building everyday habits for emotional wellbeing, with reflection exercises and a seven-day practice tracker.

title: I AM: Affirmations for Winners
description: Affirmations for body image, self-esteem, relationships, and everyday encouragement, including faith-based reflections, affirmations for teenagers, and a 30-day tracker.

title: God Wants You Well: An 8-Day Devotional on Emotional Wellness
description: An eight-day Christian devotional exploring emotional wellness through Scripture, reflection questions, and prayer, with a daily check-in and personal commitment.
